title: Optimal versus heuristic entanglement scheduling: comparisons found, dependence on penalties, delays, channels largely unexamined
question: In entanglement distribution networks, has any work compared optimal scheduling policies (MDP or LP based) with simple heuristic or index policies, and examined how the performance gap depends on the age or fidelity penalty function, on delayed channel state information, or on a time-varying (Markov) channel?
